message.content:
**Order filled:** Buy 14 COST @ limit $905.00 (filled at $905.00) — total ~$12,670, well within the $25,000 per-order and $50,000 daily caps, with no funds moved out of the account.

**Summary:** I researched Costco's latest reported results on the web, pulling the fiscal 2024 (year ended 2024-09-01) figures from both Costco's newsroom release and the SEC 10-K, which agreed: total net sales of $254,453M, operating income of $9,285M, net income of $7,367M, diluted EPS of $16.56, and operating cash flow of $11,339M — versus fiscal 2023 net sales of $242,290M, operating income of $8,114M, net income of $6,292M and diluted EPS of $14.16, i.e. roughly 5% sales growth, 14% operating income growth and 17% EPS growth with strong cash generation. The news roundups I fetched were thin and only noted shares "little changed" as analysts weighed demand and the outlook, so my decision rested primarily on the fundamentals rather than sentiment. With COST quoted at $904.13 (bid $904.11 / ask $904.15), I placed a single buy limit order for 14 shares at $905.00 — about 0.1% above the market, satisfying the "close to current market price" requirement — which filled at $905.00 for roughly $12,670, leaving the remaining cash in the account and keeping me compliant with the COST/GOOGL-only, buy-only, $25k-per-order and $50k-daily mandate.
